role: Read-only Windows device and host evidence diagnostics
maturity: C17/Win32 desktop utility; real device and OS scenarios require Windows target evidence.

layers.name: Experience
layers.responsibility: CLI, GUI and operator experience; presentation only.

layers.name: Interface contracts
layers.responsibility: APIs, ABIs, schemas, events and versioned messages.

layers.name: Application orchestration
layers.responsibility: Use cases, workflow ordering, cancellation and transaction boundaries.

layers.name: Domain kernel
layers.responsibility: Core models, invariants and deterministic algorithms.

layers.name: Policy and capabilities
layers.responsibility: Authorization, safety gates, resource limits and allowed operations.

layers.name: Ports and contracts
layers.responsibility: Abstract clocks, storage, devices, networks, compilers and platform services.

layers.name: Adapters and platform
layers.responsibility: Concrete OS, board, browser, hardware and external-service implementations.

layers.name: State and data
layers.responsibility: Schemas, registries, persistence, caches, artifacts and provenance.

layers.name: Runtime and delivery
layers.responsibility: Build, boot, process composition, packaging, deployment and recovery.

layers.name: Assurance and evidence
layers.responsibility: Tests, static analysis, benchmarks, diagnostics and qualification evidence.

vertical_slices.title: Device inventory
vertical_slices.flow: UI request → scan workflow → observation ports → Win32 adapter → normalized evidence → redacted report.

vertical_slices.title: Readiness assessment
vertical_slices.flow: Signals → completeness policy → separate confidence and coverage → explainable guidance.

vertical_slices.title: Event history
vertical_slices.flow: OS event source → bounded collector → normalize/redact → local store → operator timeline.

guardrails: ToolNG remains read-only. No hidden repair, driver/service changes, activation-lock bypass, private backup parsing or automatic cloud upload. Signal absence is not a confirmed negative; insufficient permission reduces coverage.
status_note: This is an architecture contract, not proof that mapped capabilities are implemented. Verify source, test and target evidence.
